reviews.review: Something for the more mindless folk. Lot of content and fun for the whole family.

Come get the full experience of living in Australia without being robbed by meth heads!

I blew up the city to stop the aliens from blowing up the city.

You level cities to save cities from insects trying to level cities. XCOM be damned. This is how you repel alien invaders!

The only game where it is acceptable to blow up your entire neighborhood because there was a spider on your wall.

Pick 2 weapons, start a level, blow sh*t up, collect more weapons and armor, end level. That's it.

Game is full of bugs, though.

Literally.

First you take ya Kaiju movies and 60's B-movie monster flicks (Them! Earth vs the spider, the swarm etc) Now add in some basic but solid and fun 3rd person shooter mechanics, throw in some Resident Evil grade voice acting, cover that sh*t in some Japanese cheese (the best kind of cheese), a pinch of mecha anime, a dash of dark comedy and BAM! Ya got an EDF.

EDF5 is a phenomenal goofy shooter game. It's simplistic mechanically, the story is so stupid it's funny, the progression is simple but satisfying. It's a great co-op shooter to sorta mindlessly kill bugs in. It’s a great concept and story, as long as you like that b movie camp they're going for. Genuinely one of the few games out there where it feels like you're fighting armies of monsters. It's great!

It's a very fun game, loads of ridiculous enemies and weapons. There are plenty of questionable design decisions and it's generally quite janky, but more than makes up for it in hype and laughs. Higher difficulties require a surprising amount of tactics but it's certainly more of a "brain off" game. Again yes the game is stupid. Stupid in its narrative. Stupid in its delivery. Stupid in its enemy design. It's stupid in the number of enemies. Absolutely insanely stupid weapon design and power levels. In short, it's a stupidly fun and fantastic game. Much improved with a few good friends who don't mind occasionally blowing each other up. "Accidently".

Buy it. Cause the only good bug. Is a dead bug.

10/10
Only complaint is that a certain enemy looked exactly like a giant human, threw me off so hard.
